title: PiD 1.5: bench it against the shipped nvidia-pid; if 1.5 wins, it replaces it
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-1267 - LTX 2.5 release (joined 2026-10-24, Fabio; moved from MPI-1179 New Models to Test). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-1267/plan.md. ComfyUI v0.28.0 lists 'Support PID 1.5 models' (#14894), a newer generation of the PixelDiT upscaler we ship as nvidia-pid. Fabio 2026-10-24: test the old and the new side by side; if 1.5 wins it REPLACES nvidia-pid (he expects it will). Details: brief.md.
